headline: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) Earnings Beat Puts Valuation Back In Focus
summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) is back in focus after reporting fourth quarter and full year 2026 results that topped analyst expectations, along with fresh guidance, a higher dividend and a new share repurchase plan. headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Broadridge Financial, Raises Price Target to $176
summary: Morgan Stanley  analyst James Faucette   maintains Broadridge Financial (NYSE:BR) with a Equal-Weight and raises the price target from $169 to $176.
